semantics: UNKNOWN is insufficient evidence now; UNAVAILABLE is unsupported or deliberately disabled. Neither authorizes actions.
AVAILABLE/LIMITED are valid only within declared scope and current generation; LIMITED is never implicit whole-job authority.
Error code/reason contains no token, arbitrary native stderr or secret path. Typed internal values do not add Linux MCP output fields.

semantics: admit serializes stop/reaper by job+owner epoch and durably commits before returning; persistence error means no signal. Same active job generation/request is idempotent.
open_signals pins verified targets for the admitted epoch or refuses; it does not signal. observe must account for all authorized targets, not only leader exit.

record atomically validates owner/request epoch and commits outcome. Success requires closed target set AND persisted closed receipt; errors never convert to success. Existing Linux record fields and RPC v1 preserved; new admission metadata is additive and old readers stay readable.
B0 owns store/owner/reaper coordinator wiring; A1 owns orchestration. No second source writer.

semantics: A1 additive entrypoint: admit first, then open one lease, TERM, observe full closure, KILL on same lease only if needed, record final receipt before acknowledgement; close lease in finally.

Durable admission survives crash before/after signal. Epoch mismatch/store failure/partial delivery/uncertain closure produce failed or unknown receipt/error, never stopped. Concurrent reaper uses the same coordinator serialization; no historic PID recovery.
B0 integrates this entrypoint into shared owner flow after A1 independent review; legacy stop_embedded remains import compatible.

semantics: Generation strings are identifiers, never bearer secrets or ownership proof. Authenticated live channel and positive enrollment are required.
In this revision can_signal=False in shipped Darwin adapters. A2 may exercise owned direct-child mechanisms only in isolated tests.
Loss of manager and witness yields UNKNOWN, membership_closed=False, can_signal=False. Reconnect cannot reconstruct capabilities from persisted PID/PGID/birth/boot.
RootGrant and OpenedFile own descriptors; idempotent close, use-after-close rejected. Caller closes in finally; app lifetime owns grants.

Captured configured canonical root is opened once. Traverse relative components with dir_fd and no-follow checks; reject absolute path, dotdot, symlink/reparse ambiguity. Never reopen an authorized pathname.

Opened-object semantics: grant follows the original directory object across rename, never replacement path. Newly encountered moved/symlink objects are rejected if authority cannot be proved. No continuous pathname confinement or hostile same-UID guarantee.
Regular files only for content. Read has a hard byte budget. Missing/denied/TCC-possible paths never become empty results.

write_bytes owns parent FD, temporary file, flush/fsync/rename cleanup. expected_sha256 guards detected content conflicts for edits, not hostile concurrent-writer serializability. No follow of existing symlink; reject hardlinked mutation unless writing a replacement entry.

Search enumerates through grant and supplies each authorized open regular file to rg stdin, uses bounded resources and remaps stdin events to relative display path. Never pass an unchecked root path or /dev/fd directory to recursive rg. Ignore/glob parity requires native tests; unsupported cases error explicitly.

Plan is pure. Apply validates no foreign overwrite and records previous bytes; rollback restores only its own exact prior state and positively verifies service/child/socket absence. Quiet active-job gate always applies to manager mutations.
